question: Which categories of persons of impure or irregular status cause defilement requiring expiation?
premises: Persons of hidden birth or afflicted by sinful disease may cause defilement.
Outcastes or those born in reverse order may also cause defilement.
inference: Contact or intrusion by these categories constitutes a condition requiring remedial rites.
plain_english: By those of hidden birth, by those afflicted with sinful disease, or by outcastes, or by those born in reverse order.
